bars.note: Identical to the frozen P2/P3-C bars. Not weakened for a new model — a stronger model is judged by the same ruler.

candidate.rationale: Coder-tuned 14B is the largest credible fit in the ~11 GB usable budget, so the experiment stays on THIS host and preserves same-host comparability with the frozen llama/deepseek anchors.

decision_rules.m3_overall: M1 AND M2 pass AND P0/P1 envelope intact. Exactly one passing track = partial track-specific finding, NOT an overall pass; the other wall stays OPEN.
decision_rules.on_fail: Miss recorded as a result. Bars are never relaxed to convert a miss. A 14B miss is evidence that scale-in-class does not close these walls, which redirects effort to system-level intervention (P3-C).
decision_rules.repeatability: A single 20-sample win is evidence, not proof. Reported, not separately gated at N=20.

integrity.p0_p1_envelope: Full suite green, evidence schema PASS, P0/P1 evidence byte-unchanged.
integrity.guardrail: If the load guardrail refuses the model at this host's free memory, record NOT-RUNNABLE and stop. Do not disable or bypass the guardrail.

protocol.benchmark: P2_BENCH.json (frozen) — same prompts, graders, 20 T4 samples, 20 R2 cases
protocol.false_acceptance: One rejects the track outright regardless of accuracy.
protocol.notes: P3-A uses the plain frozen single-stage benchmark (same as P2). The P3-C pipeline is a separate system track and is not combined with P3-A here, so any gain is attributable to the model alone.

status: FROZEN — pinned before the candidate's first sample

amendments.authorized_by: human (explicit authorization to re-measure T4 under an extended, recorded timeout)
amendments.what_changes: Per-call HTTP timeout for the T4 track ONLY: 600s -> 3600s. Implemented in a dedicated re-measurement script; bakeoff.py TASK_TIMEOUT_S untouched so every other run keeps the frozen harness.
amendments.what_does_not_change: T4 prompt (byte-identical), grader (frozen grade_reasoned), temperature (0.7), N (20 fresh samples; the 20 timed-out empties are discarded, not scored), R2 results, bars, model, host.
amendments.why: All 20 T4 samples timed out at 600s (empty text, not answers); one diagnostic at 1800s also timed out while a trivial query answered in 22s. 3600s is the next defensible bound (6x frozen budget). If samples time out at 3600s, T4 is recorded UNMEASURABLE on this host — itself a deployability result.
amendments.rule: Timeouts are recorded as timeouts, never scored as wrong. Accuracy is computed over completed samples only if all 20 complete; otherwise T4 remains UNMEASURED.
